jobs.title: Family Care Coordinator - Sacramento
jobs.description:
DCI Donor Services

Sierra Donor Services (SDS) is looking for a dynamic and enthusiastic team member to join us to save lives!! Our mission at SDS is to save lives through organ donation and we want professionals on our team that will embrace this important work!! Specifically, people with expertise in communicating in difficult situations and building relationships with patients and their families similar to counseling or patient relations. This position, Family Care Coordinator, will work with organ donor families, hospital personnel, physicians, and other team members from SDS to work through the donation process for saving lives through organ and tissue donation. Primary work environment is in the hospital setting in the Sacramento area. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively in both oral and written formats are a must.

COMPANY OVERVIEW AND MISSION

Sierra Donor Services is a designated organ procurement organization (OPO) within the state of California and is a member of the DCI Donor Services family.

For over four decades, DCI Donor Services has been a leader in working to end the transplant waiting list. Our unique approach to service allows for nationwide donation, transplantation, and distribution of organs and tissues while maintaining close ties to our local communities.

DCI Donor Services operates organ procurement/tissue recovery organizations: Sierra Donor Services and Tennessee Donor Services with operations in the states of California, New Mexico, and Tennessee. We also maximize the gift of life through the DCI Donor Services Tissue Bank and Sierra Donor Services Eye Bank.

Our performance is measured by the way we serve donor families and recipients. To be successful in this endeavor is our ultimate mission. By mobili

jobs.title: Senior Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Newport Beach, California | Full-Time


A growing Newport Beach plastic surgery practice led by a nationally recognized plastic surgeon is seeking an exceptional and highly experienced Senior Patient Care Coordinator to join our team.


This is not an entry-level administrative position. We are looking for a proven cosmetic surgery professional who understands the psychology of the aesthetic patient, knows how to build trust and communicate value, and has demonstrated success converting qualified consultations into booked surgical procedures.


The ideal candidate combines exceptional interpersonal skills with strong sales instincts, organization, professionalism, and genuine patient care. You should be comfortable working with discerning cosmetic patients considering high-value elective procedures and understand that successful aesthetic sales are built through education, responsiveness, trust, follow-through, and an exceptional patient experience.


The Role


The Senior Patient Care Coordinator serves as one of the primary relationships between our patients and surgeon, guiding prospective patients from their initial inquiry and consultation through surgery and the postoperative experience.


Your primary responsibility will be to develop strong patient relationships, communicate the value of our surgeons and services, and convert qualified prospective patients into booked surgical procedures while delivering an exceptional level of service.


Responsibilities include:



 Conduct comprehensive cosmetic surgery consultations and guide patients through their treatment options and surgical journey.
 Clearly communicate procedure recommendations, surgeon qualifications, expected patient experience, fees, financing options, and practice policies.
 Prepare accurate surgical proposals and financial quotes and follow prospective patients through the decision-making process.
 Build trust, identify patient concerns, navigate objections thoughtfully, and convert qualified consultations into booked procedures.
 Proactively and consistently follow up with new inquiries, consultations, previous leads, and prospective patients through phone, text, email, and CRM systems.
 Reactivate prior inquiries and consultations and identify opportunities for repeat procedures and patient referrals.
 Coordinate surgical scheduling, deposits, financing, preoperative requirements, and communication between patients, surgeons, clinical staff, and surgical facilities.
 Maintain accurate and timely documentation within the practice EMR and CRM.
 Provide outstanding communication and concierge-level service throughout the preoperative, perioperative, and postoperative experience.
 Collaborate with the practice's marketing team to maximize lead conversion, identify patient acquisition opportunities, support events and internal marketing initiatives, and strengthen patient referrals.
 Maintain strict confidentiality and adherence to HIPAA and all applicable practice policies.

Who We Are Looking For


The successful candidate will have at least five years of meaningful Patient Care Coordinator experience within cosmetic plastic surgery or a closely related high-end aesthetic medical environment.


Strong candidates will demonstrate:



 A proven track record of successfully converting cosmetic consultations into booked procedures.
 Significant experience discussing and closing high-value elective surgical procedures.
 A sophisticated understanding of the cosmetic patient and the ability to establish trust without relying on high-pressure sales tactics.
 Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills in person, by phone, text, and email.
 A warm, polished, professional, confident, and highly service-oriented presence.
 Strong follow-up discipline and the ability to manage a large pipeline of prospective patients without allowing opportunities to fall through the cracks.
 Excellent organizational skills and meticulous attention to detail.
 Experience with EMR and CRM platforms and confidence learning new technology.
 Strong computer skills, including proficiency with Microsoft Office and modern digital communication platforms.
 Experience with patient financing and financial discussions surrounding elective procedures.
 The ability to work independently, take ownership of results, and identify opportunities to improve patient conversion and the overall patient experience.
 High integrity, discretion, accountability, and respect for patient confidentiality.

Experience with practice growth, internal marketing, social media, events, referral development, or aesthetic practice management is a significant plus.


Orange County candidates and candidates with established experience in the Southern California cosmetic surgery market are preferred.


What Success Looks Like


We are looking for someone who views this position as more than scheduling and administration.


A successful coordinator will become a trusted extension of our surgeon and an advocate for our patients. You will understand where every prospective patient is within the decision-making process, follow up consistently and intelligently, and help patients feel confident and well cared for from their first interaction with the practice.


Performance will be measured not simply by activity, but by patient experience, responsiveness, consultation conversion, surgical bookings, follow-up discipline, and contribution to the growth of the practice.


Compensation & Schedule


Full-time, Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM–5:00 PM

  Newport Beach, California


Compensation will include a competitive base salary plus performance-based incentive compensation, with significant earning potential for an experienced, high-performing cosmetic surgery coordinator.


Specific compensation will be based on experience and demonstrated performance.


How to Apply


Please submit:



 Your current resume
 A brief cover letter describing your cosmetic surgery or aesthetic sales experience

Join Our Team at Skin and Cancer Institute

Are you passionate about dermatology and skin health? Do you thrive in a dynamic, patient-focused environment? Skin and Cancer Institute is looking for dedicated professionals to join our team

Why Join Us?

At Skin and Cancer Institute, we are committed to excellence in dermatology, skin cancer treatment, and cosmetic procedures. We offer a supportive and collaborative work culture where your skills and dedication make a real impact.

Summary of Position

Work Location: 1805 West Avenue K, Lancaster CA 93534Work Category: Non-exempt, Full-time/Regular, On-siteThe Patient Care Coordinator serves as the first point of contact for patients and visitors, ensuring a welcoming and professional environment. This role is responsible for managing front desk operations, scheduling appointments, verifying insurance, collecting payments, and supporting clinical staff with administrative tasks. The ideal candidate will demonstrate excellent communication skills, attention to detail, a commitment to patient care and confidentiality, and maintain professional grooming and appearance at all times.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

Patient Intake & Front Desk Operations

Greet patients professionally and courteously, check patients in and out in accordance with Customer Service standards.Collect all required patient information at check-in (NPP, insurance, ID, demographics, CCOF).Maintain accurate and up-to-date patient charts, demographic, and insurance information in EMA.Maintain a clean, organized, and professional reception area and restroom facilitiesScheduling & Appointment Management

Schedule, confirm, and adjust patient appointments in accordance with company protocols.Maintain and update provider schedules within organizational guidelines.Anticipate and respond appropriately to schedule changes and extended wait times.Insurance Verification & Authorizations

Verify primary and secondary insurance prior to scheduled visits following established protocols.Accurately identify and differentiate HMO, PPO, POS, and Medicare plans and authorization requirements.Enter correct payer ID, payer name, and address information into EMA.Update and maintain the PA log, ensuring accuracy of codes and documentation.Financial & Payment Responsibilities

Collect all required patient financial responsibilities, including co-pays, co-insurance, deductibles, and cosmetic payments.Process cosmetic sales through Lightspeed POS.Obtain and document CCOF forms when applicable.Accurately document payment notes; balance and reconcile daily payments collected during each shift.Prepare and generate superbills accurately and in a timely manner.Communication & Patient Experience

Maintain timely, professional, and consistent communication via Microsoft Teams, Klara, email, and phone during scheduled work hoursDe-escalate and resolve patient concerns and grievances using effective, respectful communication techniques.Ask every patient for a Google review in alignment with customer service guidelines.Compliance & Documentation

Maintain strict compliance with HIPAA regulations and ensure confidentiality of patient information at all times.Accurately close all daily tasks; ensure end-of-day documentation is complete and uploaded to the shared drive.General Administrative Support

Support clinical and administrative staff with daily operational needs as assignedPerform other duties as assigned to support overall clinic operations.WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

Required Skills & Abilities

Strong customer service and interpersonal skillsEffective verbal and written communication skillsKnowledge of primary and secondary insurance types, billing, and documentation proceduresProficiency in Microsoft Office and EMA software and LightspeedAbility to stay focused on tasks to be accomplished while working in dynamic situationsAbility to maintain HIPAA confidentiality and professionalismConfidently and professionally ask for and process financial paymentsEducation & Experience

High school diploma or equivalent required.1–2 years of experience in a medical office or customer service role preferred.Familiarity with HIPAA regulations and healthcare operations.Additional training or certification in medical office administration is preferreEQUIPMENT & SOFTWARE OPERATION

Microsoft 365 apps, fax, email, phone, Klara, EMA, ModMed, iPAD, NoahFace (biometric timeclock), Tandem, CoverMyMeds, LabCorp (software for looking up labs results and ordering supplies), Quest diagnostic
